description:
The Sport and Signature Edition are the same trailer just in different colors.

The Singletrailer II Sport 24" TT Signature Edition is the ultimate, premium single-wheel suspended child carrier engineered for uncompromising off-road control and sporty mountain bike use.

This Tout Terrain child bike trailer features a lightweight steel frame and advanced adjustable suspension to keep your child safe and comfortable on even the roughest trails. The innovative, redesigned drawbar is optimized for improved compatibility with 29" mountain bikes and E-MTBs, ensuring tight, smooth, and stable connection over the most difficult terrain.

Key Features for Off-Road Performance:
Age/Weight Capacity: Safe and comfortable for children from 3-months to 5-years (up to 25kg).

Superior Handling: Single-wheel design and precise machined alloy drawbar crosslink offer unrivalled handling, making tough climbs and technical descents pure pleasure.

Passenger Comfort: Features a comfortable cabin interior and an adjustable, weatherproof ripstop cover.

Hitch Compatibility: Requires proper hitch and shim selection for your seatpost size (e.g., 27.2, 30.9, 31.6).

Please ensure you select the correct hitch and shim for your bicycle's seatpost.

Please select the correct hitch and shim.

27.2 seatpost will need a 30.0 hitch and 27.2 shim

30.9 seatpost will need a 35.0 hitch and 30.9 shim

31.6 seatpost will need a 35.0 hitch and 31.6 shim

Please message us using the chat feature or email us at sales@tout-terrain.bike if you need a different size or are unsure of the size needed..
